params.body:
## What Shane saw

In the own-stock list, a tap on a vehicle's portal icons opened a panel "PORTALS" with one green switch per portal, on and disabled (`aria-disabled="true"`), and the footer "Individueel aan/uit komt binnenkort". A placeholder from an earlier design round that shipped.

## What changes

The panel is made honest; the feature is not built.

- The switches are gone. The panel lists the portals the vehicle is on, each with the same mark the row draws (`x-ui.portal-icon`, favicon or monogram). No `role="switch"`, no control pretending to be one.
- "komt binnenkort" is replaced by a real action: the link **Portalen aanpassen** to the Data step of the vehicle sheet (`?tab=dates`, the step name `VehicleForm::initialStep()` accepts; no hard-coded number). A draft links to the create sheet with the same query.
- Empty state: a complete vehicle on no portal, at a dealer who has portals, shows a grey chip "Geen portalen" (like "Geen Car-Pass") that opens the same panel with "Deze wagen staat op geen enkel portaal." and the same link. A draft is on no portal by definition (S2-4.2) and a dealer without portals has nothing to choose, so those rows show nothing, as before. The dealer's portals are read once per page through the logged-in user, not per row.
- The row's icon strip now uses `x-ui.portal-icon` too instead of its own copy of the monogram logic.
- Dead CSS removed (`.ui-portal-toggle*`, `.ui-portals-hint`); `.ui-portal-row` is a list item now, plus `.ui-portals-list`, `.ui-portals-empty`, `.ui-portals-edit`.

## Not built, recorded

Per-portal on/off from the list already exists on the sheet (`OwnStockService::finalizeEdit` syncs `portal_ids`, the observer sends `update` to Hexon and the other receivers, chapter S2-10). A toggle in a list row that fires that message on every tap is a feature with consequences. It is an open point: `docs/bedrijfsregels/open-punten/2026-09-15-portalen-per-wagen-schakelen-in-de-lijst.md`, with the question for Ilse whether dealers want it in the list at all. `90-x-bevindingen.md` and `91-o-open-punten.md` are untouched.

## Rules and tests

- New screen rule R P1-1.17 in `31-p1-dagelijks-werk.md`.
- `OwnStockRowMarkupTest` (tagged `@rule P1-1.17`) renders the real row and asserts on the parsed document: no `role="switch"`, no `aria-disabled`, no "binnenkort", the two portal names with their marks, the link and its exact `href`; and the empty state (no panel for a dealer without portals, "Geen portalen" plus link when the dealer has portals).
- `php artisan test --filter='OwnStockRowMarkup|OwnStockList|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|VehicleFormPortalIcon'`: OK (36 tests, 730 assertions). `RulesDocsBuild` and `BuildContract` green as well.

Screenshots (1440 px and 390 px, before and after, plus the empty state) were taken locally against a seeded database.
params.title: The portals panel drops its placeholder toggles
